On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.
Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay is seeking an experienced and dedicated Audio Visual Technician to join our team.

The Audio Visual Technician is responsible for the installation, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all audio-visual, communication, and presentation systems throughout the hotel. This role is essential in ensuring the successful execution of conferences, meetings, events, and guest experiences by providing professional technical support and maintaining the highest operational standards.
q: Diploma or Degree in Audio Visual Technology, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as an Audio Visual Technician, preferably within a luxury hotel, hospitality, conference, or events environment.
Strong knowledge of audio systems, video displays, projectors, conferencing solutions, and lighting controls.
Strong knowledge of analog/digital audio, Yamaha & QSC mixers, DSP, and signal flow
Experience in ballroom, meeting room, conference, and live event operations
Experience with troubleshooting AV and communication systems.
Basic understanding of networking and IT infrastructure is an advantage.
Knowledge of IPTV, CCTV, BGM and digital signage operation, configuration, and troubleshooting
Practical experience with Dante, network amplifiers, IP/VLAN networking, and AMX control systems
Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as required by hotel operations.
Strong technical expertise and attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively under pressure.
Able to operate and troubleshoot hybrid meetings, including Logitech Rally, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex
Commitment to maintaining the luxury standards of Four Seasons.
Join Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay and become part of a world-class team dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for our guests.
r: Install, set up, operate, and maintain audio-visual equipment, including projectors, screens, sound systems, microphones, video conferencing equipment, and presentation technologies.
Provide technical support for conferences, meetings, weddings, banquets, and special events held within the hotel.
Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and repairs on all audio-visual systems and equipment.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly to minimize disruption to hotel operations and guest events.
Coordinate with Banquets, Events, IT, and Engineering teams to ensure all AV requirements are met efficiently.

Recommend improvements and upgrades to enhance AV capabilities and guest experiences.
Provide exceptional service to guests and internal stakeholders while responding to AV-related requests.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
